testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, navigation link, card item, form element, and badge MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or modals. Use heavy blur (backdrop-filter: blur(16px)) with solid tinted dark background rgba(20, 22, 28, 0.95).
Ensure APCA gold-on-dark contrast ratio requirements: headlines use gold (#D4A03C) or off-white (#F4F4F6) with subtle dark shadows.
All interactive elements must have clear hover states with gold hairline glow borders and smooth CSS transitions (transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease).
Include data-testid on all interactive and data display components.
